name: Documentation Problem
about: A document that is wrong, missing, misleading, or overstates how finished something is

assignees: ''
---

> If the problem reveals an **unfixed** weakness in the shipped system,
> see `SECURITY.md` and email instead. If the document is simply wrong
> and the system is fine, a public issue is better — it gets fixed
> faster.

## Which document

Path, and the claim or section at issue.

## What kind of problem

- [ ] Factually wrong — the system does not behave as described
- [ ] Stale — was true, no longer is
- [ ] Overstates completeness — reads as finished, is not
- [ ] Missing — something that should be documented and is not
- [ ] Contradicts another document (please link both)
- [ ] Unverifiable claim — stated so it cannot be checked

## What it says, and what is actually true

The quote, then the reality. If you have a command or measurement that
shows the difference, include it — a documented number that disagrees
with a measured one is the most useful kind of report here.

## How you found it

Useful because it suggests what else may be stale: reading the document,
following it and getting a different result, or noticing it disagree
with another file.
